datasheet_identity.title: MMSZ5221B THRU MMSZ5267B SURFACE MOUNT ZENER DIODES

extraction_notes: This is a family datasheet; the MMSZ5239B row was selected from the MMSZ5221B through MMSZ5267B table.
The Fig. 1 points are digitized readings from the plotted 9.1 V MMSZ5239B trace; current values were converted from mA to A and no intermediate points were interpolated.
The MMSZ5239B electrical-characteristics row gives VZ = 8.65 V minimum, 9.10 V nominal, and 9.56 V maximum at IZT = 20 mA; maximum ZZT is 10 ohm, IR is 3 microA maximum at VR = 7.0 V.
The table heading labels ZZT as ZZT@IZT=0.25mA while the MMSZ5239B row specifies IZT = 20 mA; no separate IZK or ZZK value is published, so zener impedance is not represented as a scalar spec.

Figures 4 through 6 are series-wide typical plots without a uniquely identified MMSZ5239B bias-specific trace or tabulated target value; they were not assigned component-specific capacitance or leakage points.
No capacitance value, reverse-recovery time, or reverse-recovery test circuit is published for MMSZ5239B in the supplied datasheet.
